statement: An employee is in continuous employment for Employment Ordinance purposes after employment under a contract of employment for 4 or more weeks, where a week counts if the employee has worked 17 hours or more in it, or has worked 68 hours or more in the aggregate of that week and the 3 preceding weeks of employment (Employment Ordinance First Schedule paragraphs 2 and 2A as amended by the Employment (Amendment) Ordinance 2025, in operation from 28 December 2025).
caveat: Weeks beginning before the 2025 amendment's operation date (and the first 3 weeks after the last pre-amendment week) still count on the former 18-hour test. Continuous-contract status gates the Ordinance's main entitlements (rest days, paid annual leave, sickness allowance, severance and long service payments); basic protections such as wage payment apply to all employees regardless.
